name: Bee Hotel VertiCal
description: A vertical availability calendar (units x days) for Bee Hotel daily management, with AJAX cell state toggles and per-unit permissions.
project_description: Bee Hotel VertiCal renders a vertical calendar of units by days for daily hotel management at /admin/beehotel/vertical. Each cell is a flip-card showing availability/occupancy and order data; AJAX callbacks toggle or save a night's availability state as a BAT availability_daily event. A settings form controls display, and a set of permissions (access_vertical_basic/full, administer vertical settings, per-bundle view permissions) gates access. The controller is backed by a refactored set of builder/renderer/resolver services.
